title: Nestle rolls out AI safety tech across entire truck fleet
description: KUALA LANGAT: Nestle Malaysia Bhd has achieved 100 per cent GPS, artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled dashcam and telematics coverage across its existing transporter fleet in an effort to enhance visibility across its transport operations.

title: I built an AI career companion to solve my own job hunting frustrations 🚀
description: Job hunting today feels like a full-time job in itself. Between hopping across dozens of company career pages, digging through outdated listings, and scrambling to prepare for interviews, the process can get overwhelming really quickly. While looking for tech roles myself, I realized how fragmented this workflow was. I wanted a way to keep my job search and interview prep in one place without having 30 tabs constantly open. So, I built JOBLES (jobles.tech) – a free AI-powered career companion to bring some order to this chaos. Here’s a quick breakdown of what I tried to solve: 1. Direct Company Career Page Aggregation 📂 Usually, the freshest and most authentic roles are on the company's own site, but checking them manually is exhausting. JOBLES aggregates open roles directly from company career pages so you can catch genuine listings early. 2. AI Job Discovery 🔍 To help you cut through the noise, you can describe what you're looking for, and JOBLES will help find roles that actually align with your skillset. No more browsing through endlessly generic, outdated boards. 3. Built-in AI Interview Prep 💬 Finding the role is only half the battle. Once you get a bite, you can use JOBLES's integrated AI interview prep tool to practice responses and build confidence for the real thing. The Stack 💻 Since I wanted to move fast and keep it lightweight, I built the app using FastAPI (for a robust, speedy backend) paired with an AI/LLM orchestration layer, and designed a clean frontend using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Try it out! 🙌 I’m actively working on this side project and need honest feedback from developers, job seekers, and designers. Check it out at jobles.tech! What features should I add next? What feels clunky? Please roast my project or share your thoughts in the comments below! 👇

title: Hasna Cabral’s daughter Basha asks public to stop making AI images of late mom
description: Basha, the daughter of former “Pinoy Big Brother: Otso” housemate Hasna Cabral, has appealed to social media users to stop creating AI-generated images featuring her late mother, saying the content makes her deeply uncomfortable. In a Facebook post on Wednesday, Nov. 25, Basha asked those who had created AI-generated thumbnails of the actress to remove them out of respect for their family. “Hey daughter of Hasna Cabral here. I do not like when people make AI thumbnails of my mom who passed away. I’m very DEEPLY uncomfortable,” she wrote. “Respectfully, if you’re one of these people who made AI thumbnails of […]...
